verification.note: CONFIRMED unchanged 2026-08-25. Qualifying earnings band 6,240-50,270; minimum total 8% (employee 5% + employer 3%).

notes: Relief method changes the arithmetic, not just the label — this is the single most common source of wrong UK pension figures.
`net-pay-arrangement`: contribution is deducted from GROSS pay before Income Tax, so it reduces taxable income. NI is still charged on the full amount.
`salary-sacrifice`: contribution reduces gross pay before BOTH Income Tax and NI, so it also reduces the NI bill. This is why sacrifice is worth more than net-pay for the same percentage.

`relief-at-source`: contribution is taken from NET pay and the scheme reclaims 20% basic-rate relief. Higher-rate relief is claimed separately via Self Assessment and does NOT appear in take-home pay.
Default is net-pay-arrangement because that is the most common workplace arrangement, but the user must be able to change it.
